column6: @wDN{Nergal} who ……, …… great awe, who …… the underworld -- its awesome radiance …… the battle-net, its awesomeness has filled heaven and earth.

Hero, wild bull with thick horns, …… like a cow, your terrifying name lets loose awe and fear. You fall on the rebel lands like the south wind. You are a bolt on the broad extent of the mountains. When you sit in @wTN{E-mešlam}, your desires are joyously fulfilled. The people assemble at your feet.
@wDN{Mešlamta-ea}, your supremacy in the rebel lands! You have encircled the rebel lands, O youth. @wDN{Nergal}, your supremacy in the rebel lands!
Your father loves you greatly. He has made your heroism known among the people. Your father @wDN{Enlil} loves you greatly. He has made your heroism known among the people.
Hero …… for the people, god roaming the mountains! You have …… the rebel lands. @wDN{Nergal} …… for the people, god roaming the mountains!
Wherever you stride, all their troops suffer. …… @wGN{Anšan} and @wGN{Tidnum}, @wDN{Nergal}, wherever you stride, all their troops suffer.
May you prolong the life of the hero @wRN{Šulgi}. …… to his strength, …….
